# ThorVG provenance

- Upstream: https://github.com/thorvg/thorvg
- Version: 1.2.0
- Commit: `5654bbbb13c518c93ce159569838b329c0af85a7`
- License: MIT (`LICENSE` in this directory)
- Included features: CPU raster engine, SVG loader, raw loader, C API, file I/O,
  partial rendering, and worker-thread support.

This is the minimal source closure used by the Stasis SVG runtime. Unused ThorVG
loaders, GPU engines, tools, examples, and tests are intentionally omitted.
